findings.evidence: grep: `(hermite n).map (Int.castRingHom ℝ)` at Schwartz.lean:54,93, MemLp.lean:57, HilbertBasis.lean:47, Hermite/MemLp.lean:49; degree_hermiteℝ proof at Basis.lean:75 identical to hmap at HilbertBasis.lean:47-48. No named real-cast Hermite exists in Mathlib (only Polynomial.hermite : ℤ[X]).
findings.fix: Move hermiteℝ, eval_hermiteℝ, degree_hermiteℝ down to the shared Hermite polynomial layer (e.g. alongside TauCeti/RingTheory/Polynomial/Hermite/Derivative.lean) so hermiteDilated can be defined as (hermiteℝ n).comp (C (√2) * X) and degree_hermiteDilated's hmap becomes `degree_hermiteℝ n`, eliminating the clones.
findings.issue: hermiteℝ n := (hermite n).map (Int.castRingHom ℝ) and degree_hermiteℝ duplicate an idiom already present anonymously in four merged files: Function/Schwartz.lean:54,93; Function/MemLp.lean:57 (hermiteDilated); Function/HilbertBasis.lean:47; Gaussian/Hermite/MemLp.lean:49. degree_hermiteℝ (line 74-75) is the verbatim proof of the inline `have hmap` in degree_hermiteDilated (Function/HilbertBasis.lean:47-48). Placed in this leaf file, the new named abstraction cannot be reused by any of those existing sites.

summary: The PR reuses the weighted-measure and pi-basis machinery and the existing Gaussian orthogonality lemma correctly, and shares gaussianPDFReal_zero_one via a new Basic file. Only issue: the new hermiteℝ abstraction and its degree lemma re-derive an idiom already inlined in four existing files but sit in a leaf file where those sites cannot adopt it.
